title: Progressive Rock
tagline: Rock that stretches its forms through long compositions and adventurous arrangements.
summary: Progressive rock expands the scope of rock through long songs, shifting meters, conceptual albums, and influences from classical and jazz music. It became prominent in the late 1960s and 1970s, with bands exploring new studio techniques and instrumental arrangements. Later generations adapted its ambition to many different sounds.

pillars.name: Yes
pillars.why: Yes developed intricate arrangements and extended compositions that became central to progressive rock.

pillars.name: King Crimson
pillars.why: King Crimson's changing lineups and adventurous structures helped define the genre's experimental edge.

pillars.name: Genesis
pillars.why: Genesis combined theatrical storytelling, instrumental passages, and carefully composed albums.
